Input: {"post_id":"2100420165917982857","context":{"post":"@TechBuzzChina The more interesting divide may be integrated ecosystems vs standalone model companies. Tencent, Alibaba or ByteDance can treat the model as one layer of a much larger business. A pure-play lab has much less cushion when model pricing compresses - the model economics are much closer to the business itself.","local_parent":"DeepSeek's Flash price cut hits Zhipu and MiniMax valuations

On September 10, DeepSeek released V4.1 Flash and cut API prices again. Off-peak cached input now costs RMB 0.02 (~$0.0028) per million tokens, uncached input RMB 1 (~$0.14), and output RMB 4 (~$0.55). Peak pricing is double. The company says the new model beats V4 Pro on performance, cost, speed, and total time, and plans to shift some Pro traffic to Flash after September 14.

Zhipu fell 10.34% that day and MiniMax 8.98%. Through September 11, Zhipu is down 33.64% for the month and MiniMax 22.98%. Both reported strong first-half revenue: Zhipu RMB 954 million (~$131.6M), up 399.7% year over year, and MiniMax $117 million, up 283.1%. Zhipu disclosed August ARR of about $1.6 billion; MiniMax over $800 million.

Yet Jefferies cut Zhipu's target price from HK$1,299.8 to HK$1,183.79 and lowered the API business multiple from 50x to 30x expected 2026 ARR. The bank also raised 2026-2029 revenue forecasts 37-119% and trimmed loss estimates. The market is repricing growth quality: Zhipu's two largest customers each contribute over $250 million ARR, at least 31% combined. If one reduces usage, annualized ARR drops immediately.

We'd argue the core tension is that Flash models compress the premium window. Zhipu raised API prices 83% in Q1 and still grew call volume 400%, but GLM-5.3-Flash costs one-tenth of GLM-5.3 while outperforming GLM-5.2. Cached input generates 50x less revenue per token than uncached. Independent model companies must now grow call volume faster than unit prices fall, and cut inference costs faster than list prices drop. That is a much harder race than the one investors priced six months ago.

h/t @TMTPostGlobal"}}
